proves.claim: launchBackgroundView starts the detached view with its stdout and stderr on its port log file, so a line the server writes to stderr after the starting command has let go lands in the log and does not end the server.

view.io-background.error-output-goes-to-.why: The server's stderr was a pipe back to the exiting parent; its first warning hit the closed pipe and the server exited silently about 2 s after the browser opened it.
